<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,user-scalable=no">
<title>白刃 / BLADE BLOOM</title>
<style>
  html,body{margin:0;padding:0;width:100%;height:100%;background:#05070c;overflow:hidden;
    -webkit-user-select:none;user-select:none;touch-action:none;}
  canvas{display:block;position:fixed;left:0;top:0;}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="c"></canvas>
<script>
"use strict";
(function(){

/* =====================================================================
   工具
   ===================================================================== */
var TAU = Math.PI*2;
function clamp(v,a,b){ return v<a?a:(v>b?b:v); }
function lerp(a,b,t){ return a+(b-a)*t; }
function rnd(a,b){ return a+Math.random()*(b-a); }
function sgn(v){ return v<0?-1:1; }
function approach(v,t,d){ return v<t ? Math.min(v+d,t) : Math.max(v-d,t); }
function easeOut(t){ t=clamp(t,0,1); return 1-(1-t)*(1-t); }
function easeIn(t){ t=clamp(t,0,1); return t*t; }
function easeIO(t){ t=clamp(t,0,1); return t<0.5?2*t*t:1-Math.pow(-2*t+2,2)*0.5; }
function circleRect(cx,cy,r,b){
  var nx=clamp(cx,b.x,b.x+b.w), ny=clamp(cy,b.y,b.y+b.h);
  var dx=cx-nx, dy=cy-ny;
  return dx*dx+dy*dy <= r*r;
}
function rectsOverlap(a,b){
  return a.x < b.x+b.w && a.x+a.w > b.x && a.y < b.y+b.h && a.y+a.h > b.y;
}
var FONT = 'system-ui,-apple-system,"PingFang SC","Hiragino Sans GB","Microsoft YaHei",sans-serif';

/* =====================================================================
   画布
   ===================================================================== */
var cvs = document.getElementById('c');
var ctx = cvs.getContext('2d', {alpha:false});
var DPR=1, SCALE=1, VW=1280, VH=720, CW=960, CH=540;

function resize(){
  CW = Math.max(320, window.innerWidth || 960);
  CH = Math.max(240, window.innerHeight || 540);
  DPR = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
  cvs.width  = Math.floor(CW*DPR);
  cvs.height = Math.floor(CH*DPR);
  cvs.style.width  = CW+'px';
  cvs.style.height = CH+'px';
  SCALE = Math.min(CH/720, CW/960);
  VW = CW/SCALE;
  VH = CH/SCALE;
}
window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
resize();

/* =====================================================================
   音频合成
   ===================================================================== */
var AU = {
  ac:null, master:null, muted:false, buf:null,
  init:function(){
    if(this.ac){
      if(this.ac.state === 'suspended'){ try{ this.ac.resume(); }catch(e){} }
      return;
    }
    try{
      var AC = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
      if(!AC) return;
      this.ac = new AC();
      this.master = this.ac.createGain();
      this.master.gain.value = this.muted ? 0 : 0.5;
      this.master.connect(this.ac.destination);
      var n = Math.floor(this.ac.sampleRate*0.8);
      var b = this.ac.createBuffer(1, n, this.ac.sampleRate);
      var d = b.getChannelData(0);
      for(var i=0;i<n;i++) d[i] = Math.random()*2-1;
      this.buf = b;
    }catch(e){ this.ac = null; }
  },
  mute:function(m){
    this.muted = !!m;
    if(this.master){ try{ this.master.gain.value = m?0:0.5; }catch(e){} }
  },
  tone:function(f0,f1,dur,type,vol,delay){
    if(!this.ac || this.muted) return;
    try{
      var t0 = this.ac.currentTime + (delay||0);
      var o = this.ac.createOscillator(), g = this.ac.createGain();
      o.type = type || 'sine';
      o.frequency.setValueAtTime(Math.max(20,f0), t0);
      if(f1 && f1 !== f0) o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(Math.max(20,f1), t0+dur);
      g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, t0);
      g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(vol, t0+0.008);
      g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, t0+dur);
      o.connect(g); g.connect(this.master);
      o.start(t0); o.stop(t0+dur+0.03);
    }catch(e){}
  },
  noise:function(dur,vol,f0,f1,q,delay){
    if(!this.ac || this.muted || !this.buf) return;
    try{
      var t0 = this.ac.currentTime + (delay||0);
      var s = this.ac.createBufferSource(); s.buffer = this.buf;
      var bp = this.ac.createBiquadFilter();
      bp.type = 'bandpass'; bp.Q.value = q||1;
      bp.frequency.setValueAtTime(Math.max(40,f0), t0);
      bp.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(Math.max(40,f1), t0+dur);
      var g = this.ac.createGain();
      g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, t0);
      g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(vol, t0+0.005);
      g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, t0+dur);
      s.connect(bp); bp.connect(g); g.connect(this.master);
      s.start(t0); s.stop(t0+dur+0.03);
    }catch(e){}
  }
};

var S = {
  slash:function(p){ AU.noise(0.10+0.04*p, 0.15+0.07*p, 4200, 900, 2.0); AU.tone(880+520*p, 260, 0.09, 'triangle', 0.045); },
  hit:function(p){ AU.noise(0.07+p*0.05, 0.28+p*0.14, 2400, 300, 0.8); AU.tone(190-p*60, 62, 0.09+p*0.05, 'square', 0.13+p*0.06); },
  heavy:function(){ AU.noise(0.28,0.34,1100,120,0.9); AU.tone(160,42,0.26,'sawtooth',0.17); },
  brk:function(){ AU.noise(0.24,0.38,700,100,0.7); AU.tone(150,42,0.22,'square',0.15); AU.tone(1250,380,0.10,'triangle',0.075,0.02); },
  dash:function(){ AU.noise(0.20,0.15,1200,200,1.2); },
  jump:function(){ AU.tone(340,640,0.10,'triangle',0.075); },
  land:function(){ AU.noise(0.09,0.12,320,90,0.8); },
  hurt:function(){ AU.noise(0.24,0.28,700,120,0.7); AU.tone(250,80,0.20,'sawtooth',0.12); },
  kill:function(){ AU.noise(0.32,0.30,1800,110,0.6); AU.tone(520,60,0.30,'sawtooth',0.13); },
  shoot:function(){ AU.tone(1050,320,0.12,'square',0.055); AU.noise(0.08,0.07,2600,700,1.5); },
  wave:function(){ AU.tone(330,660,0.18,'sine',0.075); AU.tone(495,990,0.22,'sine',0.045,0.07); },
  up:function(){ AU.tone(520,1500,0.16,'triangle',0.08); AU.noise(0.18,0.13,2600,700,1.6); },
  charge:function(){ AU.tone(120,340,0.22,'sawtooth',0.05); }
};

/* =====================================================================
   输入
   ===================================================================== */
var keys = {left:false,right:false,jump:false,atk:false,heavy:false,dash:false,up:false};
var BUF = {jump:0,atk:0,heavy:0,dash:0,up:0};
var KM = {
  ArrowLeft:'left', KeyA:'left',
  ArrowRight:'right', KeyD:'right',
  Space:'jump',
  KeyJ:'atk', KeyK:'heavy', KeyL:'dash', KeyI:'up'
};
var GAMEKEYS = {ArrowLeft:1,ArrowRight:1,ArrowUp:1,ArrowDown:1,Space:1,KeyA:1,KeyD:1,KeyJ:1,KeyK:1,KeyL:1,KeyI:1,KeyR:1,Enter:1,NumpadEnter:1};

function clearInput(){
  for(var k in keys) keys[k] = false;
  for(var b in BUF) BUF[b] = 0;
}

window.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){
  if(GAMEKEYS[e.code]){
    e.preventDefault();
    try{ e.stopPropagation(); }catch(err){}
  }
  AU.init();
  if(e.repeat) return;
  if(e.code === 'Enter' || e.code === 'NumpadEnter'){
    if(G.state !== 'play') startGame();
    return;
  }
  if(e.code === 'KeyR'){ startGame(); return; }
  var a = KM[e.code];
  if(!a) return;
  keys[a] = true;
  if(BUF[a] !== undefined) BUF[a] = 0.17;
}, {passive:false});

window.addEventListener('keyup', function(e){
  var a = KM[e.code];
  if(!a) return;
  if(GAMEKEYS[e.code]){ e.preventDefault(); }
  keys[a] = false;
}, {passive:false});

window.addEventListener('blur', clearInput);
document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', function(){ if(document.hidden) clearInput(); });
window.addEventListener('contextmenu', function(e){ e.preventDefault(); });

function muteRect(){
  return {x: VW-66, y:18, w:48, h:38};
}
cvs.addEventListener('mousedown', function(e){
  AU.init();
  var r = cvs.getBoundingClientRect();
  var vx = (e.clientX - r.left)/SCALE;
  var vy = (e.clientY - r.top)/SCALE;
  var m = muteRect();
  if(vx>=m.x && vx<=m.x+m.w && vy>=m.y && vy<=m.y+m.h){
    AU.mute(!AU.muted);
    return;
  }
  if(G.state !== 'play') startGame();
});

/* =====================================================================
   全局状态
   ===================================================================== */
var GROUND = 600;
var ARENA = 2600;
var GRAV = 2300;

var G = {
  state:'title',
  t:0,
  hitstop:0,
  shake:0,
  flash:0,
  red:0,
  wave:0,
  waveTimer:1.2,
  spawnQ:[],
  spawnT:0,
  hitCount:0,
  limbBreak:0,
  kills:0,
  combo:0,
  comboT:0,
  best:0,
  banner:'',
  bannerT:0,
  deathT:0,
  slow:0
};

var cam = {x:0, y:0, sx:0, sy:0, shake:0, punch:0};

var enemies = [];
var orbs = [];
var fx = [];
var limbs = [];
var shocks = [];
var decals = [];
var nums = [];
var EID = 0;

/* =====================================================================
   玩家
   ===================================================================== */
var P = {
  x:ARENA*0.5, y:GROUND, vx:0, vy:0, facing:1,
  hp:100, maxHp:100, ghost:100,
  onGround:true, jumps:0, airDash:1,
  atk:null, chain:0, airChain:0, comboT:0,
  armAng:1.9, trail:[], trailOn:false,
  dashT:0, dashDir:1, dashCd:0,
  inv:0, hurtT:0,
  upCd:0, chargeT:0, charging:false,
  dead:false, scarf:[], anim:0
};
for(var si=0; si<6; si++) P.scarf.push({x:P.x-si*9, y:P.y-86+si*3});

function swordPts(){
  var f = P.facing, ang = P.armAng;
  var shy = P.y - 96;
  var c = Math.cos(ang), s = Math.sin(ang);
  var hx = P.x + f*(2 + c*26);
  var hy = shy + s*26;
  var tx = P.x + f*(2 + c*(26+88));
  var ty = shy + s*(26+88);
  return {hx:hx, hy:hy, tx:tx, ty:ty, ang:ang};
}

function playerBox(){ return {x:P.x-16, y:P.y-112, w:32, h:112}; }

/* ---------------- 攻击表 ---------------- */
var ATT = {
  s1:{wind:0.045, act:0.09, rec:0.13, box:[8,-124,112,112], dmg:9,  kb:170, hs:0.050, part:1.00, a0:-2.30, a1:-1.75, a2:1.00, sfx:0.25, shake:3},
  s2:{wind:0.045, act:0.09, rec:0.14, box:[8,-132,118,120], dmg:10, kb:180, hs:0.055, part:1.05, a0:1.10,  a1:0.55,  a2:-1.70, sfx:0.3,  shake:3},
  s3:{wind:0.11,  act:0.11, rec:0.24, box:[2,-158,158,172], dmg:20, kb:470, hs:0.105, part:1.75, a0:-1.10, a1:-2.40, a2:1.15, sfx:0.9, shake:8, pierce:true, launch:-330, lunge:260},
  a1:{wind:0.045, act:0.08, rec:0.12, box:[6,-126,112,116], dmg:9,  kb:110, hs:0.050, part:1.00, a0:-1.60, a1:-1.05, a2:0.95, sfx:0.25, shake:3},
  a2:{wind:0.055, act:0.09, rec:0.17, box:[2,-138,128,132], dmg:14, kb:230, hs:0.080, part:1.35, a0:0.95,  a1:0.20,  a2:-1.95, sfx:0.6, shake:5, pierce:true, launch:-210},
  up:{wind:0.10,  act:0.10, rec:0.20, box:[-6,-186,128,208], dmg:14, kb:70, hs:0.095, part:1.55, a0:1.40, a1:0.60, a2:-2.00, sfx:0.8, shake:6, pierce:true, launch:-930},
  hv:{wind:0.16,  act:0.12, rec:0.28, box:[-2,-166,168,182], dmg:30, kb:560, hs:0.125, part:2.30, a0:-2.85, a1:-2.45, a2:0.65, sfx:1.0, shake:11, pierce:true, launch:-260, lunge:200},
  dv:{wind:0.07,  act:0.60, rec:0.22, box:[-46,-96,92,110], dmg:26, kb:300, hs:0.130, part:2.20, a0:-0.35, a1:0.70, a2:1.57, sfx:0.8, shake:8, pierce:true}
};

function atkBox(d){
  var f = P.facing, ox=d.box[0], oy=d.box[1], w=d.box[2], h=d.box[3];
  var x = f>0 ? P.x+ox : P.x-ox-w;
  return {x:x, y:P.y+oy, w:w, h:h};
}

function startAtk(key){
  var d = ATT[key];
  P.atk = {key:key, d:d, t:0, hit:{}, fired:false};
  if(d.lunge) P.vx = P.facing*d.lunge;
  S.slash(d.sfx||0.3);
  if(d.sfx > 0.85) G.shake = Math.max(G.shake, 3);
}

/* ---------------- 玩家更新 ---------------- */
function updatePlayer(dt){
  P.anim += dt;
  if(P.inv>0) P.inv -= dt;
  if(P.hurtT>0) P.hurtT -= dt;
  if(P.dashCd>0) P.dashCd -= dt;
  if(P.upCd>0) P.upCd -= dt;
  if(P.comboT>0){ P.comboT -= dt; if(P.comboT<=0){ P.chain=0; P.airChain=0; } }
  P.ghost = approach(P.ghost, P.hp, dt*95);

  if(P.dead){
    P.vy += GRAV*dt;
    P.y += P.vy*dt;
    P.x += P.vx*dt;
    P.vx = approach(P.vx, 0, dt*900);
    if(P.y > GROUND){ P.y = GROUND; P.vy = 0; }
    updateScarf(dt);
    return;
  }

  var dir = (keys.right?1:0) - (keys.left?1:0);

  /* 冲刺 */
  if(P.dashT > 0){
    P.dashT -= dt;
    P.vx = P.dashDir*900;
    P.vy = 0;
    if(P.dashT <= 0){
      P.vx = P.dashDir*280;
      if(!P.onGround) P.vy = 60;
    }
  } else {
    var spd = P.atk ? 70 : 330;
    if(dir !== 0){
      P.vx = approach(P.vx, dir*spd, dt*(P.onGround?3800:1900));
      if(!P.atk) P.facing = dir;
    } else {
      P.vx = approach(P.vx, 0, dt*(P.onGround?3400:700));
    }
  }

  /* 重力 */
  if(P.dashT <= 0){
    P.vy += GRAV*dt;
    if(P.vy > 1600) P.vy = 1600;
  }
  P.x += P.vx*dt;
  P.y += P.vy*dt;
  P.x = clamp(P.x, 30, ARENA-30);

  if(P.y >= GROUND){
    if(!P.onGround){
      P.onGround = true;
      P.jumps = 0;
      P.airDash = 1;
      if(P.vy > 620){
        S.land();
        spawnDust(P.x, GROUND, 6);
        G.shake = Math.max(G.shake, 2.2);
      }
      if(P.atk && P.atk.key === 'dv'){ diveImpact(); }
    }
    P.y = GROUND; P.vy = 0;
  } else {
    P.onGround = false;
  }

  /* 蓄力 */
  if(P.charging){
    P.chargeT += dt;
    if(P.chargeT > 1.1) P.chargeT = 1.1;
    if(Math.random() < dt*26){
      var q = swordPts();
      fx.push({t:'spark', x:q.tx+rnd(-10,10), y:q.ty+rnd(-10,10), vx:rnd(-40,40), vy:rnd(-90,-20),
        life:0.28, max:0.28, size:2.2, col:'#ffe08a', grav:-60, drag:1.5});
    }
    if(!keys.heavy){
      P.charging = false;
      startAtk('hv');
      spawnRing(P.x, P.y-90, '#ffe08a', 46);
      G.shake = Math.max(G.shake, 4);
    }
  }

  /* 攻击推进 */
  if(P.atk){
    var a = P.atk, d = a.d;
    a.t += dt;

    if(d === ATT.dv){
      if(!P.onGround) P.vy = 1250;
    }

    if(a.t > d.wind && a.t < d.wind + d.act){
      resolveAtk(a, d);
    }
    if(a.t >= d.wind + d.act + d.rec){
      P.atk = null;
    }
  }

  /* 输入消费 */
  var d2 = P.atk ? P.atk.d : null;
  var cancelOk  = !P.atk || P.atk.t >= d2.wind + d2.act*0.75;
  var chainOk   = !P.atk || P.atk.t >= d2.wind + d2.act + d2.rec*0.30;

  if(P.hurtT <= 0){
    if(BUF.dash > 0 && P.dashCd <= 0 && cancelOk && P.dashT <= 0 && (P.onGround || P.airDash > 0)){
      BUF.dash = 0; doDash();
    } else if(BUF.up > 0 && chainOk && P.upCd <= 0){
      BUF.up = 0; doUp();
    } else if(BUF.heavy > 0 && chainOk){
      BUF.heavy = 0; doHeavy();
    } else if(BUF.atk > 0 && chainOk){
      BUF.atk = 0; doAtk();
    } else if(BUF.jump > 0 && cancelOk){
      if(P.onGround || P.jumps < 2){ BUF.jump = 0; doJump(); }
    }
  }

  P.armAng = computeArmAng();
  updateScarf(dt);
  updateTrail(dt);
}

function doDash(){
  P.dashT = 0.17;
  P.dashCd = 0.24;
  P.dashDir = P.facing;
  P.atk = null;
  P.charging = false;
  P.chargeT = 0;
  P.vy = 0;
  P.inv = Math.max(P.inv, 0.16);
  if(!P.onGround) P.airDash--;
  S.dash();
  spawnRing(P.x, P.y-60, '#7ee8ff', 26);
  spawnDust(P.x, P.y, 4);
}

function doJump(){
  if(P.onGround){
    P.vy = -980;
    P.onGround = false;
    P.jumps = 1;
    P.atk = null;
    P.charging = false;
    S.jump();
    spawnDust(P.x, GROUND, 5);
  } else {
    P.vy = -830;
    P.jumps = 2;
    S.jump();
    spawnRing(P.x, P.y-30, '#9ff0ff', 28);
    for(var i=0;i<8;i++){
      fx.push({t:'spark', x:P.x+rnd(-12,12), y:P.y-10, vx:rnd(-90,90), vy:rnd(30,160),
        life:0.3, max:0.3, size:2, col:'#9ff0ff', grav:400, drag:1.6});
    }
  }
}

function doUp(){
  P.upCd = 0.62;
  startAtk('up');
  S.up();
  if(P.onGround){ P.onGround = false; P.vy = -420; }
  else { P.vy = Math.min(P.vy, -260); }
  P.charging = false;
}

function doHeavy(){
  if(!P.onGround){
    startAtk('dv');
    P.vy = 620;
    P.charging = false;
  } else {
    P.charging = true;
    P.chargeT = 0;
    S.charge();
  }
}

function doAtk(){
  P.charging = false;
  P.chargeT = 0;
  if(P.onGround){
    if(!P.atk || P.comboT <= 0) P.chain = 0;
    P.chain = P.chain >= 3 ? 1 : P.chain+1;
    P.comboT = 0.85;
    startAtk('s'+P.chain);
  } else {
    if(!P.atk || P.comboT <= 0) P.airChain = 0;
    P.airChain = P.airChain >= 2 ? 1 : P.airChain+1;
    P.comboT = 0.85;
    startAtk('a'+P.airChain);
  }
}

function computeArmAng(){
  if(P.atk){
    var d = P.atk.d, t = P.atk.t;
    if(t < d.wind) return lerp(d.a0, d.a1, easeOut(t/Math.max(0.001,d.wind)));
    if(t < d.wind + d.act) return lerp(d.a1, d.a2, easeOut((t-d.wind)/Math.max(0.001,d.act)));
    var k = clamp((t - d.wind - d.act)/Math.max(0.001,d.rec), 0, 1);
    return lerp(d.a2, 1.9, easeIO(k));
  }
  if(P.dashT > 0) return 0.35;
  if(!P.onGround) return 1.35;
  if(Math.abs(P.vx) > 40) return 1.55;
  return 1.92 + Math.sin(P.anim*2.1)*0.06;
}

function updateTrail(dt){
  for(var i=P.trail.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    P.trail[i].life -= dt;
    if(P.trail[i].life <= 0) P.trail.splice(i,1);
  }
  if(P.atk){
    var d = P.atk.d, t = P.atk.t;
    if(t > d.wind*0.55 && t < d.wind + d.act + d.rec*0.55){
      var q = swordPts();
      P.trail.push({hx:q.hx, hy:q.hy, tx:q.tx, ty:q.ty, life:0.14, max:0.14, hv:d.pierce?1:0});
      if(P.trail.length > 14) P.trail.shift();
    }
  }
  if(P.dashT > 0 && Math.random() < 0.8){
    fx.push({t:'ghost', x:P.x, y:P.y, f:P.facing, ang:P.armAng, life:0.22, max:0.22});
  }
}

function updateScarf(dt){
  var ax = P.x - P.facing*8, ay = P.y - 88;
  for(var i=0;i<P.scarf.length;i++){
    var s = P.scarf[i];
    var tx = ax, ty = ay + i*3.2;
    if(i > 0){ tx = P.scarf[i-1].x; ty = P.scarf[i-1].y + 3.2; }
    s.x = lerp(s.x, tx - P.facing*(6+i*1.2), 1-Math.pow(0.00002, dt));
    s.y = lerp(s.y, ty + Math.sin(G.t*7 + i*0.8)*1.6, 1-Math.pow(0.0002, dt));
  }
}

/* ---------------- 攻击判定 ---------------- */
function resolveAtk(a, d){
  var hb = atkBox(d);
  for(var i=0;i<enemies.length;i++){
    var e = enemies[i];
    if(e.dead || e.spawnT > 0) continue;
    if(a.hit[e.id]) continue;
    if(!rectsOverlap(hb, enemyBox(e))) continue;
    a.hit[e.id] = 1;
    damageEnemy(e, d, hb);
  }
  for(var j=orbs.length-1;j>=0;j--){
    var o = orbs[j];
    if(o.x > hb.x && o.x < hb.x+hb.w && o.y > hb.y && o.y < hb.y+hb.h){
      popOrb(o, j);
    }
  }
}

function enemyBox(e){
  if(e.def.fly) return {x:e.x-e.w*0.5, y:e.y-e.h*0.5, w:e.w, h:e.h};
  return {x:e.x-e.w*0.5, y:e.y-e.h, w:e.w, h:e.h};
}

/* ---------------- 伤害 ---------------- */
function damageEnemy(e, d, hb){
  var f = P.facing;
  var dmg = d.dmg;
  if(e.def.armor && !d.pierce) dmg *= 0.38;
  e.hp -= dmg;
  e.flash = 0.13;

  var broke = 0;
  var iP = e.parts.length;
  for(var i=0;i<iP;i++){
    var p = e.parts[i];
    if(p.severed) continue;
    var pp = partPos(e, p);
    if(circleRect(pp.x, pp.y, p.r, hb)){
      p.hp -= dmg * d.part;
      if(p.hp <= 0){
        severPart(e, p, d);
        broke++;
      }
    }
  }

  /* 命中点 */
  var hx = clamp(e.x, hb.x, hb.x+hb.w);
  var hy = clamp(e.y - (e.def.fly?0:e.h*0.55), hb.y, hb.y+hb.h);

  var hs = d.hs * (broke ? 1.55 : 1);
  hitstop(hs);
  G.shake = Math.max(G.shake, (d.shake||3) * (broke?1.9:1));
  G.punch = Math.max(G.punch||0, 0.25 + (broke?0.5:0));
  cam.punch = Math.max(cam.punch, 0.35 + (broke?0.7:0));
  G.hitCount++;
  G.combo++;
  G.comboT = 2.0;
  if(G.combo > G.best) G.best = G.combo;

  /* 击退 / 浮空 */
  var kb = d.kb || 120;
  if(!e.def.fly){
    e.vx += f*kb*(e.def.armor?0.42:1);
    if(d.launch){
      e.vy = d.launch;
      e.onGround = false;
      e.stun = Math.max(e.stun, 0.55);
      e.state = 'approach';
      e.cd = Math.max(e.cd, 0.35);
    } else {
      e.stun = Math.max(e.stun, d.pierce?0.34:0.20);
    }
  } else {
    e.vx += f*kb*0.55;
    e.vy += (d.launch ? d.launch*0.35 : -40);
    e.stun = Math.max(e.stun, 0.20);
  }

  if(d.pierce && !e.dead && e.state === 'wind' && Math.random() < 0.85){
    e.state = 'recover'; e.st = 0; e.cd = Math.max(e.cd, 0.5);
  }

  spawnHitSpark(hx, hy, f, d.pierce ? 1 : 0.5, e.def.col2);
  nums.push({x:hx, y:hy-10, vy:-120, life:0.65, max:0.65, val:Math.round(dmg), col:broke?'#ffd267':'#dff6ff'});
  S.hit(d.pierce ? 0.9 : 0.25);

  if(e.hp <= 0){ killEnemy(e, false); }
}

function partPos(e, p){
  var ox = p.ox, oy = p.oy;
  if(p.kind === 'leg' && !e.def.fly && e.state === 'approach' && !e.dead){
    var ph = e.t*9 + (p.ox > 0 ? 0 : Math.PI);
    ox += Math.sin(ph)*7;
    oy -= Math.max(0, Math.cos(ph))*4;
  }
  if(p.kind === 'arm' && !e.dead){
    if(e.state === 'wind'){ ox -= e.facing*0; oy -= 8; }
    if(e.state === 'strike'){ ox += 8; oy += 4; }
  }
  return {x:e.x + e.facing*ox, y:e.y + oy};
}

function severPart(e, p, d){
  p.severed = true;
  G.limbBreak++;
  var pp = partPos(e, p);

  limbs.push({
    x:pp.x, y:pp.y,
    vx: e.vx*0.4 + P.facing*rnd(140,340) + rnd(-60,60),
    vy: rnd(-520,-200),
    rot: rnd(0,TAU), vrot: rnd(-14,14),
    r: p.r, kind: p.kind, type: e.type,
    col: e.def.col, col2: e.def.col2, dark: e.def.dark,
    life: 5.0, max: 5.0
  });

  S.brk();
  hitstop(0.095);
  G.shake = Math.max(G.shake, 8);
  cam.punch = Math.max(cam.punch, 0.9);
  spawnBurst(pp.x, pp.y, e.def.col, 16);
  spawnBurst(pp.x, pp.y, e.def.col2, 7);
  spawnRing(pp.x, pp.y, e.def.col2, 40);
  decals.push({x:pp.x, r:rnd(16,30), life:6, max:6});

  if(p.kind === 'head'){
    e.hp = -9999;
    killEnemy(e, true);
  } else if(p.kind === 'leg'){
    e.legs--;
    e.stun = Math.max(e.stun, 0.35);
  } else if(p.kind === 'arm'){
    if(p.main) e.armed = false;
    e.stun = Math.max(e.stun, 0.28);
  } else if(p.kind === 'pod'){
    e.pods--;
    e.stun = Math.max(e.stun, 0.25);
  }
}

function killEnemy(e, exec){
  if(e.dead) return;
  e.dead = true;
  e.deadT = 0;
  e.hp = 0;
  G.kills++;
  hitstop(exec ? 0.16 : 0.09);
  G.shake = Math.max(G.shake, exec ? 15 : 8);
  cam.punch = Math.max(cam.punch, exec ? 1.6 : 0.8);
  G.flash = Math.max(G.flash, exec ? 0.55 : 0.25);

}

  for(var i=0;i<enemies.length;i++) if(!enemies[i].dead) n++;

  for(var i=enemies.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    var e = enemies[i];
    updateEnemy(e, dt);
    if(e.remove) enemies.splice(i,1);
  }
}

function updateEnemy(e, dt){
  e.t += dt;
  if(e.flash > 0) e.flash -= dt;
  if(e.stun > 0) e.stun -= dt;
  if(e.cd > 0) e.cd -= dt;

  if(e.dead){
    e.deadT += dt;
    e.vy += GRAV*0.9*dt;
    e.x += e.vx*dt;
    e.y += e.vy*dt;
    e.vx *= Math.pow(0.1, dt);
    e.rot += e.vrot*dt;
    if(!e.def.fly && e.y > GROUND){
      if(e.vy > 260){ spawnDust(e.x, GROUND, 4); }
      e.y = GROUND;
      e.vy *= -0.26;
      e.vx *= 0.65;
      e.vrot *= 0.6;
      if(Math.abs(e.vy) < 70) e.vy = 0;
    }
    if(e.deadT > 2.4) e.remove = true;
    return;
  }

  if(e.spawnT > 0){
    e.spawnT -= dt;
    if(!e.def.fly) e.y = GROUND;
    return;
  }

  /* 物理 */
  if(e.def.fly){
    e.x += e.vx*dt;
    e.y += e.vy*dt;
    e.vx *= Math.pow(0.05, dt);
    e.vy *= Math.pow(0.05, dt);
    e.y = clamp(e.y, 130, GROUND-70);
  } else {
    e.vy += GRAV*dt;
    e.x += e.vx*dt;
    e.y += e.vy*dt;
    if(e.y >= GROUND){
      if(!e.onGround && e.vy > 620){
        spawnDust(e.x, GROUND, 6);
        G.shake = Math.max(G.shake, 2);
      }
      e.y = GROUND; e.vy = 0; e.onGround = true;
    } else e.onGround = false;
    if(e.onGround) e.vx = approach(e.vx, 0, dt*(e.state==='strike'?600:1500));
    else e.vx *= Math.pow(0.5, dt);
  }
  e.x = clamp(e.x, 40, ARENA-40);

  /* 双腿断裂 → 倒地 */
  if(!e.def.fly && e.legs <= 0){
    e.collapsed = true;
    e.hp -= dt*45;
    if(Math.random() < dt*14){
      var pcx = e.x + rnd(-20,20), pcy = e.y - 14;
      fx.push({t:'spark', x:pcx, y:pcy, vx:rnd(-40,40), vy:rnd(-140,-30),
        life:0.4, max:0.4, size:2, col:e.def.col, grav:600, drag:1.4});
    }
    if(e.hp <= 0){ killEnemy(e, false); return; }
  }

  if(e.stun > 0 || P.dead) return;

  if(e.type === 'slasher') aiSlasher(e, dt);
  else if(e.type === 'brute') aiBrute(e, dt);
  else aiDrone(e, dt);
}

function aiSlasher(e, dt){
  var dx = P.x - e.x, adx = Math.abs(dx), dir = sgn(dx) || 1;
  var sp = e.def.spd * (e.legs >= 2 ? 1 : (e.legs === 1 ? 0.5 : 0.12));

  if(e.state === 'approach'){
    e.facing = dir;
    if(adx > e.def.reach*0.85) e.vx = approach(e.vx, dir*sp, dt*1700);
    else e.vx = approach(e.vx, 0, dt*2200);
    if(e.cd <= 0){
      if(e.armed && adx < e.def.reach*1.4){ e.state='wind'; e.st=0; e.weak=false; }
      else if(!e.armed && adx < 62){ e.state='wind'; e.st=0; e.weak=true; }
    }
  } else if(e.state === 'wind'){
    e.st += dt;
    e.vx = approach(e.vx, 0, dt*2400);
    e.facing = dir;
    if(e.st >= (e.weak ? 0.34 : 0.40)){
      e.state='strike'; e.st=0; e.hitDone=false;
      e.vx = dir * (e.weak ? 200 : 720);
    }
  } else if(e.state === 'strike'){
    e.st += dt;
    if(!e.hitDone && e.st < 0.14){
      var w = e.weak ? 54 : e.def.reach;
      var hb = e.facing > 0 ? {x:e.x+4, y:e.y-112, w:w, h:108} : {x:e.x-4-w, y:e.y-112, w:w, h:108};
      if(rectsOverlap(hb, playerBox())){ e.hitDone = true; hurtPlayer(e.weak?7:14, e.x, false); }
    }
    if(e.st > 0.20){ e.state='recover'; e.st=0; e.cd = rnd(0.85,1.5); e.weak=false; }
  } else if(e.state === 'recover'){
    e.st += dt;
    e.vx = approach(e.vx, 0, dt*1700);
    if(e.st > 0.34) e.state='approach';
  } else e.state='approach';
}

function aiBrute(e, dt){
  var dx = P.x - e.x, adx = Math.abs(dx), dir = sgn(dx) || 1;
  var sp = e.def.spd * (e.legs >= 2 ? 1 : 0.4);

  if(e.state === 'approach'){
    e.facing = dir;
    if(adx > e.def.reach*0.9) e.vx = approach(e.vx, dir*sp, dt*800);
    else e.vx = approach(e.vx, 0, dt*1400);
    if(e.cd <= 0){
      if(e.armed && adx < e.def.reach*1.25){ e.state='wind'; e.st=0; e.chargeMode=false; }
      else if(!e.armed && adx < 560 && adx > 170){ e.state='wind'; e.st=0; e.chargeMode=true; }
    }
  } else if(e.state === 'wind'){
    e.st += dt;
    e.vx = approach(e.vx, 0, dt*1600);
    e.facing = dir;
    if(e.st >= 0.78){
      if(e.chargeMode){ e.state='charge'; e.st=0; e.hitDone=false; e.vx = dir*640; }
      else { e.state='slam'; e.st=0; e.hitDone=false; }
    }
  } else if(e.state === 'slam'){
    e.st += dt;
    if(!e.hitDone && e.st > 0.03){
      e.hitDone = true;
      G.shake = Math.max(G.shake, 12);
      cam.punch = Math.max(cam.punch, 0.8);

    }
    if(e.st > 0.52){ e.state='recover'; e.st=0; e.cd = rnd(1.2,1.9); }
  } else if(e.state === 'charge'){
    e.st += dt;
    if(!e.hitDone && e.st < 0.46){
      var hb = {x:e.x - e.w*0.5, y:e.y - e.h, w:e.w, h:e.h};
      if(rectsOverlap(hb, playerBox())){ e.hitDone = true; hurtPlayer(16, e.x, true); }
    }
    if(e.st > 0.56){ e.state='recover'; e.st=0; e.cd = rnd(1.1,1.8); e.chargeMode=false; }
  } else if(e.state === 'recover'){
    e.st += dt;
    e.vx = approach(e.vx, 0, dt*1400);
    if(e.st > 0.5) e.state='approach';
  } else e.state='approach';
}

function aiDrone(e, dt){
  var dx = P.x - e.x, adx = Math.abs(dx), dir = sgn(dx) || 1;
  var want = 330;
  if(adx < want-70) e.vx = approach(e.vx, -dir*e.def.spd, dt*700);
  else if(adx > want+90) e.vx = approach(e.vx, dir*e.def.spd, dt*700);
  else e.vx = approach(e.vx, 0, dt*700);

  var ty = GROUND - 245 + Math.sin(e.t*0.85)*36;
  e.vy = approach(e.vy, (ty - e.y)*2.0, dt*500);
  e.facing = dir;

  if(e.state === 'approach'){
    if(e.cd <= 0 && adx < 640){ e.state='wind'; e.st=0; }
  } else if(e.state === 'wind'){
    e.st += dt;
    if(e.st >= 0.62){ e.state='shoot'; e.st=0; }
  } else if(e.state === 'shoot'){
    e.st += dt;
    if(e.st >= 0.05){
      var n = e.pods > 1 ? 3 : 1;
      var base = Math.atan2((P.y-72) - e.y, P.x - e.x);
      for(var i=0;i<n;i++){
        var a = base + (i-(n-1)/2)*0.21;
        orbs.push({x:e.x, y:e.y+4, vx:Math.cos(a)*310, vy:Math.sin(a)*310, r:8, life:3.2, col:e.def.col});
      }
      S.shoot();
      G.shake = Math.max(G.shake, 2);
      e.state='recover'; e.st=0; e.cd = rnd(1.9,2.7);
    }
  } else if(e.state === 'recover'){
    e.st += dt;
    if(e.st > 0.45) e.state='approach';
  } else e.state='approach';
}

function spawnHitSpark(x, y, dir, power, col){
  var n = Math.floor(7 + power*13);

function updateFX(dt){
  var i, f;
  for(i=fx.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    f = fx[i];
    f.life -= dt;
    if(f.life <= 0){ fx.splice(i,1); continue; }
    if(f.vx !== undefined){
      f.x += f.vx*dt;
      f.y += f.vy*dt;
      if(f.grav) f.vy += f.grav*dt;
      if(f.drag){ var k = Math.pow(0.02, dt*f.drag*0.35); f.vx *= k; f.vy *= k; }
    }
  }
  for(i=shocks.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    shocks[i].t += dt;
    if(shocks[i].t >= shocks[i].dur) shocks.splice(i,1);
  }
  for(i=decals.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    decals[i].life -= dt;
    if(decals[i].life <= 0) decals.splice(i,1);
  }
  for(i=nums.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    var nn = nums[i];
    nn.life -= dt;
    nn.y += nn.vy*dt;
    nn.vy += 240*dt;
    if(nn.life <= 0) nums.splice(i,1);
  }
}

function updateLimbs(dt){
  for(var i=limbs.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    var l = limbs[i];
    l.life -= dt;
    if(l.life <= 0){ limbs.splice(i,1); continue; }
    l.vy += GRAV*0.95*dt;
    l.x += l.vx*dt;
    l.y += l.vy*dt;
    l.rot += l.vrot*dt;
    if(l.y > GROUND){
      l.y = GROUND;
      l.vy *= -0.40;
      l.vx *= 0.68;
      l.vrot *= 0.7;
      if(Math.abs(l.vy) < 85){ l.vy = 0; l.vx *= 0.55; l.vrot *= 0.5; }
      if(Math.random() < 0.3) spawnDust(l.x, GROUND, 2);
    }
    if(l.x < 16){ l.x = 16; l.vx *= -0.55; }
    if(l.x > ARENA-16){ l.x = ARENA-16; l.vx *= -0.55; }
  }
}

function startWave(){
  G.wave++;
  var w = G.wave;
  var n = Math.min(2 + Math.floor(w*0.7), 7);
  var q = [];
  for(var i=0;i<n;i++){
    var t = 'slasher';
    if(w >= 2 && i % 4 === 3) t = 'brute';
    if(w >= 3 && i === n-1 && n > 3) t = 'drone';
    if(w >= 4 && i === 1) t = 'brute';
    if(w >= 6 && i === 2 && n >= 5) t = 'drone';
    q.push(t);
  }
  G.spawnQ = q;
  G.spawnT = 0;
  G.banner = 'WAVE ' + w;
  G.bannerT = 1.5;
  S.wave();
}

function updateWaves(dt){
  if(G.spawnQ.length > 0){
    G.spawnT -= dt;
    if(G.spawnT <= 0 && countAlive() < 6){

      G.spawnT = rnd(0.35, 0.7);

function updateCam(dt){

  tx = clamp(tx, 0, Math.max(0, ARENA - VW));

  if(P.y < GROUND - 130) ty = baseY + (P.y - (GROUND-130))*0.42;

  cam.sx = rnd(-1,1)*cam.shake;

}

var cityFar=null, cityMid=null, cityNear=null;

function makeCity(w, h, color, winColor, glowColor, seed, density){
  var cv = document.createElement('canvas');
  cv.width = w; cv.height = h;
  var g = cv.getContext('2d');
  var s = seed;
  function rr(){ s = (s*1103515245 + 12345) & 0x7fffffff; return s/0x7fffffff; }
  var rects = [];
  var x = -30;
  while(x < w + 60){
    var bw = 34 + rr()*86;
    var bh = h*(0.22 + rr()*0.70*density);
    rects.push({x:x, w:bw, h:bh, r:rr()});
    x += bw + 6 + rr()*26;
  }
  function drawSet(offset){
    for(var i=0;i<rects.length;i++){
      var r = rects[i];
      var bx = r.x + offset;
      if(bx > w + 10 || bx + r.w < -10) continue;
      g.fillStyle = color;
      g.fillRect(bx, h-r.h, r.w, r.h);
      /* 窗 */
      g.fillStyle = winColor;
      for(var wy=h-r.h+10; wy<h-10; wy+=13){
        for(var wx=bx+6; wx<bx+r.w-6; wx+=11){
          if(rr() < 0.30) g.fillRect(wx, wy, 3.5, 6);
        }
      }
      /* 顶灯 */
      if(r.r < 0.22){
        g.fillStyle = glowColor;
        g.fillRect(bx + r.w*0.5 - 2, h-r.h-5, 4, 5);
      }
      /* 边缘高光 */
      g.fillStyle = 'rgba(140,220,255,0.05)';
      g.fillRect(bx, h-r.h, 1.5, r.h);
    }
  }
  drawSet(0);
  drawSet(-w);
  return cv;
}

function buildCity(){
  cityFar  = makeCity(2048, 420, '#101a2c', 'rgba(120,210,255,0.35)', 'rgba(255,90,120,0.7)', 98765, 0.8);

}

function drawPlayerBody(x, y, f, ang, alpha, ghost){

    footB = {x:-9, y:-8};
    hipY = -58; shY = -98; headY = -114;
    lean = 4;

  ctx.lineWidth = 3;
  ctx.strokeStyle = cSkin;

  ctx.moveTo(headX-11, headY-4);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(headX-24, headY+6, headX-33, headY+15);

      var rr2 = 24 + ck*20 + Math.sin(G.t*10+q)*4;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(handX + Math.cos(aa)*rr2, handY + Math.sin(aa)*rr2, 2.6 + ck*2.4, 0, TAU);
      ctx.fillStyle = ck > 0.85 ? 'rgba(255,225,130,0.95)' : 'rgba(130,225,255,0.75)';
      ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(handX, handY, 11 + ck*13, 0, TAU);
    ctx.fillStyle = ck > 0.85 ? 'rgba(255,200,90,0.20)' : 'rgba(120,220,255,0.14)';
    ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';

  ctx.restore();
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function drawPlayer(){
  /* 影子 */
  var groundShadow = 0.34 * clamp(1 - (GROUND - P.y)/320, 0.2, 1);
  ctx.globalAlpha = groundShadow;
  ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
  ctx.beginPath();
  var sw = 26 * clamp(1 - (GROUND - P.y)/460, 0.45, 1);
  ctx.ellipse(P.x, GROUND+3, sw, sw*0.27, 0, 0, TAU);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

  /* 残影 */
  for(var i=0;i<fx.length;i++){
    if(fx[i].t === 'ghost'){
      var k = fx[i].life/fx[i].max;
      drawPlayerBody(fx[i].x, fx[i].y, fx[i].f, fx[i].ang, k*0.30, true);
    }
  }

  /* 刀光轨迹 */
  drawTrail();

  if(P.dead){
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(P.x, P.y);
    ctx.rotate(P.facing*1.45);
    ctx.translate(-P.x, -P.y);
    drawPlayerBody(P.x, P.y, P.facing, 1.0, 0.9, false);
    ctx.restore();
    return;
  }

  var blink = P.inv > 0 && Math.floor(G.t*24) % 2 === 0;
  drawPlayerBody(P.x, P.y, P.facing, P.armAng, blink ? 0.42 : 1, false);
}

function drawTrail(){
  var tr = P.trail;
  if(tr.length < 2) return;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter';
  for(var i=1;i<tr.length;i++){
    var a = tr[i-1], b = tr[i];
    var k = i/tr.length;
    var alpha = (k*k) * (b.life/b.max) * 0.42;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(a.hx, a.hy);
    ctx.lineTo(a.tx, a.ty);
    ctx.lineTo(b.tx, b.ty);
    ctx.lineTo(b.hx, b.hy);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fillStyle = b.hv ? 'rgba(255,225,140,'+alpha.toFixed(3)+')' : 'rgba(150,240,255,'+alpha.toFixed(3)+')';
    ctx.fill();
  }
  var last = tr[tr.length-1];
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(tr[0].tx, tr[0].ty);
  for(var j=1;j<tr.length;j++) ctx.lineTo(tr[j].tx, tr[j].ty);
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.55)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 2.2;
  ctx.lineCap = 'round';
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawEnemy(e){
  if(e.remove) return;
  var d = e.def;
  var alpha = 1;
  if(e.dead) alpha = clamp(1 - e.deadT/2.4, 0, 1);
  else if(e.spawnT > 0) alpha = clamp(1 - e.spawnT/0.5, 0, 1);
  if(alpha <= 0.02) return;

  var flash = e.flash > 0;
  var c1 = flash ? '#ffffff' : d.col;
  var c2 = flash ? '#ffffff' : d.col2;
  var cd = flash ? '#ffd0d0' : d.dark;

  /* 影子 */
  if(!d.fly){
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.32*alpha;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(e.x, GROUND+3, e.w*0.55, e.w*0.16, 0, 0, TAU);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  ctx.save();
  ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;

  if(d.fly){
    ctx.translate(e.x, e.y);
    if(e.dead) ctx.rotate(e.rot);
    ctx.scale(e.facing, 1);
    drawDroneBody(e, c1, c2, cd);
    ctx.restore();
    drawTelegraph(e);
    return;
  }

  ctx.translate(e.x, e.y);
  if(e.dead) ctx.rotate(e.rot);
  else if(e.collapsed) ctx.rotate(e.facing*0.55);
  ctx.scale(e.facing, 1);

  if(e.type === 'brute') drawBruteBody(e, c1, c2, cd);
  else drawSlasherBody(e, c1, c2, cd);

  ctx.restore();
  drawTelegraph(e);
}

function drawSlasherBody(e, c1, c2, cd){

  ctx.fill();

  /* 下摆 */

    if(e.state === 'wind') wa = lerp(0.55, -2.10, easeOut(e.st/(e.weak?0.34:0.40)));
    else if(e.state === 'strike') wa = 0.95;
    else if(e.state === 'recover') wa = 0.55;

    var bg = ctx.createLinearGradient(ax, ay, bx, by);

    bg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.9)');
    ctx.strokeStyle = bg;
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(ax, ay);
    ctx.lineTo(bx, by);
    ctx.lineWidth = 13;
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,50,90,0.16)';
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';
  } else {

    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(shX+16, shY+8, 5, 0, TAU);

function drawDroneBody(e, c1, c2, cd){
  var head = e.parts[0], podL = e.parts[1], podR = e.parts[2];
  var bob = Math.sin(e.t*2.2)*3;

  /* 悬浮环 */
  ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(0, bob+18, 44, 11, 0, 0, TAU);
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(165,92,255,0.35)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';

  /* 连接杆 */
  if(!podL.severed) capsule(-4, bob, podL.ox, podL.oy, 6, cd);
  if(!podR.severed) capsule(4, bob, podR.ox, podR.oy, 6, cd);

  /* 吊舱 */
  if(!podL.severed) drawPod(podL.ox, podL.oy, c1, c2, cd);
  if(!podR.severed) drawPod(podR.ox, podR.oy, c1, c2, cd);

  /* 核心 */
  if(!head.severed){
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(head.ox, head.oy+bob, 19, 0, TAU);
    ctx.fillStyle = cd;
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = c1;
    ctx.lineWidth = 2.4;
    ctx.stroke();
    /* 眼 */
    var charge = (e.state === 'wind') ? clamp(e.st/0.62, 0, 1) : 0;
    var eg = ctx.createRadialGradient(head.ox+2, head.oy+bob, 1, head.ox+2, head.oy+bob, 15);
    eg.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,255,'+(0.85+charge*0.15)+')');
    eg.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(190,120,255,'+(0.65+charge*0.35)+')');
    eg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(140,60,255,0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = eg;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(head.ox+2, head.oy+bob, 15+charge*4, 0, TAU);
    ctx.fill();
    /* 环 */
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(head.ox, head.oy+bob, 23, e.t*2, e.t*2+2.2);
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(190,140,255,0.6)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.stroke();
  }
}

function drawPod(x, y, c1, c2, cd){
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x, y-13);
  ctx.lineTo(x+12, y);
  ctx.lineTo(x, y+13);
  ctx.lineTo(x-12, y);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fillStyle = cd;
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = c1;
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(x, y, 4, 0, TAU);
  ctx.fillStyle = c2;
  ctx.fill();
}

function drawTelegraph(e){
  if(e.dead || e.spawnT > 0) return;
  var k = 0, col = e.def.col;
  if(e.state === 'wind'){
    k = e.type === 'brute' ? clamp(e.st/0.78,0,1) : (e.type === 'drone' ? clamp(e.st/0.62,0,1) : clamp(e.st/(e.weak?0.34:0.40),0,1));
  } else if(e.state === 'slam' || e.state === 'strike'){
    k = 0.35;
  }
  if(k <= 0.01) return;

  var cx = e.def.fly ? e.x : e.x;
  var cy = e.def.fly ? e.y : e.y - e.h*0.6;
  var r = (e.def.fly ? 60 : e.h*0.55) * (0.6 + k*0.9);

  ctx.save();
  ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter';
  var g = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx, cy, 2, cx, cy, r);
  g.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,255,0)');
  g.addColorStop(0.72, 'rgba(255,60,90,'+(0.10+k*0.14)+')');
  g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,40,80,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cx, cy, r, 0, TAU);
  ctx.fill();

  /* 前兆弧线 */
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cx, cy, r*0.82, -1.2 + k*0.6, 1.2 + k*0.6);
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,120,140,'+(0.25+k*0.5)+')';
  ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.restore();

  /* 警示符号 */
  if(k > 0.25){
    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.5 + 0.5*Math.sin(G.t*22);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff6b85';
    ctx.font = '700 ' + Math.round(e.def.fly?20:24) + 'px ' + FONT;
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('!', cx, cy - (e.def.fly ? 34 : e.h*0.62));
    ctx.restore();
  }
}

function drawLimbs(){
  for(var i=0;i<limbs.length;i++){
    var l = limbs[i];
    var a = clamp(l.life/l.max, 0, 1);
    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalAlpha = a;
    ctx.translate(l.x, l.y);
    ctx.rotate(l.rot);
    if(l.kind === 'head'){
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(0, 0, l.r, 0, TAU);
      ctx.fillStyle = l.dark;
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.strokeStyle = l.col;
      ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(-l.r*0.4, -2);
      ctx.lineTo(l.r*0.7, 0);
      ctx.strokeStyle = l.col2;
      ctx.lineWidth = 2.6;
      ctx.stroke();
    } else if(l.kind === 'pod'){
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(0, -l.r);
      ctx.lineTo(l.r, 0);
      ctx.lineTo(0, l.r);
      ctx.lineTo(-l.r, 0);
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fillStyle = l.dark;
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.strokeStyle = l.col;
      ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      ctx.stroke();
    } else {
      capsule(0, -l.r*1.4, 0, l.r*1.4, l.r*1.3, l.dark);
      capsule(0, -l.r*1.4, 0, l.r*1.4, l.r*0.7, l.col);
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(0, -l.r*1.4, l.r*0.7, 0, TAU);
      ctx.fillStyle = l.col2;
      ctx.fill();
    }
    /* 断口 */
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, 0, l.r*1.5, 0, TAU);
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,90,120,0.14)';
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';
    ctx.restore();
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function drawFX(){
  var i, f, k, a;
  ctx.save();
  /* 地面冲击波 */
  for(i=0;i<shocks.length;i++){
    var s = shocks[i];
    k = s.t/s.dur;
    var rr = lerp(s.r0, s.r1, easeOut(k));
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter';
    ctx.globalAlpha = (1-k)*0.75;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(s.x, s.y, rr, rr*0.30, 0, 0, TAU);
    ctx.strokeStyle = s.col;
    ctx.lineWidth = 5*(1-k)+1;
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(s.x, s.y, rr*0.65, rr*0.20, 0, 0, TAU);
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.5)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2*(1-k)+0.5;
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }
  ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';

  for(i=0;i<fx.length;i++){
    f = fx[i];
    k = f.life/f.max;
    a = clamp(k, 0, 1);
    if(f.t === 'spark'){
      ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter';
      ctx.globalAlpha = a;
      ctx.fillStyle = f.col;
      var len = f.size*(0.6 + a*1.8);
      var vx = f.vx||0, vy = f.vy||0;
      var vm = Math.hypot(vx,vy) || 1;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(f.x, f.y);
      ctx.lineTo(f.x - vx/vm*len*2.2, f.y - vy/vm*len*2.2);
      ctx.lineWidth = f.size*(0.4+a*0.7);
      ctx.strokeStyle = f.col;
      ctx.lineCap = 'round';
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';
    } else if(f.t === 'dust'){
      ctx.globalAlpha = a*0.5;
      ctx.fillStyle = f.col;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(f.x, f.y, f.size*(1.6-a*0.6), 0, TAU);
      ctx.fill();
    } else if(f.t === 'ring'){
      ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter';
      ctx.globalAlpha = a*0.8;
      var r2 = lerp(f.r0, f.r1, easeOut(1-k));
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(f.x, f.y, r2, 0, TAU);
      ctx.strokeStyle = f.col;
      ctx.lineWidth = 4*a+1;
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';
    } else if(f.t === 'flash'){
      ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter';
      var fr = f.r*(0.5 + (1-k)*0.9);
      var fg = ctx.createRadialGradient(f.x, f.y, 1, f.x, f.y, fr);
      fg.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,255,'+(a*0.95)+')');
      fg.addColorStop(0.4, 'rgba(200,240,255,'+(a*0.45)+')');
      fg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(120,200,255,0)');
      ctx.fillStyle = fg;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(f.x, f.y, fr, 0, TAU);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';
    } else if(f.t === 'cut'){
      ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter';
      ctx.globalAlpha = a;
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(f.x, f.y);
      ctx.rotate(f.ang);
      var ll = f.len*(1-k*0.3);
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(-ll*0.5, 0);
      ctx.lineTo(ll*0.5, 0);
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.9)';
      ctx.lineWidth = 3.5*a+0.5;
      ctx.lineCap = 'round';
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.strokeStyle = f.col;
      ctx.lineWidth = 8*a;
      ctx.globalAlpha = a*0.35;
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.restore();
      ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';
    }
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

  /* 伤害数字 */
  for(i=0;i<nums.length;i++){
    var n = nums[i];
    var na = clamp(n.life/n.max, 0, 1);
    ctx.globalAlpha = na;
    ctx.font = '700 19px ' + FONT;
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.55)';
    ctx.fillText(n.val, n.x+1.5, n.y+1.5);
    ctx.fillStyle = n.col;
    ctx.fillText(n.val, n.x, n.y);
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawOrbs(){
  ctx.save();
  ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter';
  for(var i=0;i<orbs.length;i++){
    var o = orbs[i];
    var g = ctx.createRadialGradient(o.x, o.y, 1, o.x, o.y, o.r*2.6);
    g.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.95)');
    g.addColorStop(0.35, o.col);
    g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(120,60,220,0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(o.x, o.y, o.r*2.6, 0, TAU);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(o.x, o.y, o.r*0.6, 0, TAU);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.restore();
}

/* =====================================================================
   HUD
   ===================================================================== */
function drawHUD(){
  setScreen();

  /* 顶部暗角 */

  tg.addColorStop(0,'rgba(0,0,0,0.55)');
  tg.addColorStop(1,'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle = tg;
  ctx.fillRect(0,0,VW,110);

  /* HP */
  var bx = 30, by = 26, bw = Math.min(310, VW*0.30), bh = 15;
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(6,10,18,0.75)';
  ctx.fillRect(bx-5, by-5, bw+10, bh+10);
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(120,220,255,0.25)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  ctx.strokeRect(bx-5.5, by-5.5, bw+11, bh+11);

  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(120,20,40,0.7)';
  ctx.fillRect(bx, by, bw, bh);
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,170,185,0.65)';
  ctx.fillRect(bx, by, bw*clamp(P.ghost/P.maxHp,0,1), bh);

  var hpw = bw*clamp(P.hp/P.maxHp,0,1);
  var hg = ctx.createLinearGradient(bx,0,bx+bw,0);
  hg.addColorStop(0,'#1ec8ee');
  hg.addColorStop(0.55,'#8df2ff');

  ctx.fillRect(bx, by, hpw, bh);

  /* 波次 */
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.font = '800 15px ' + FONT;
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(160,225,255,0.75)';
  var rem = G.spawnQ.length + countAlive();
  ctx.fillText('WAVE ' + Math.max(1,G.wave) + '   ·   残留 ' + rem, VW*0.5, 34);

  if(G.bannerT > 0){
    var bk = clamp(G.bannerT/1.5, 0, 1);
    var ea = Math.min(1, (1-bk)*6);
    ctx.globalAlpha = ea;
    ctx.font = '900 46px ' + FONT;
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
    ctx.fillText(G.banner, VW*0.5+2, VH*0.30+2);
    var bg2 = ctx.createLinearGradient(VW*0.5-160,0,VW*0.5+160,0);
    bg2.addColorStop(0,'rgba(126,232,255,0.25)');
    bg2.addColorStop(0.5,'rgba(255,255,255,1)');
    bg2.addColorStop(1,'rgba(126,232,255,0.25)');
    ctx.fillStyle = bg2;
    ctx.fillText(G.banner, VW*0.5, VH*0.30);
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  /* 连击 */
  if(G.combo > 1){
    var ck = clamp(G.comboT/2.0, 0, 1);
    var pop = 1 + Math.max(0, (G.comboT-1.75))*2.2;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(VW - 96, VH*0.30);
    ctx.scale(pop, pop);
    ctx.textAlign = 'right';
    ctx.font = '900 52px ' + FONT;
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.45)';
    ctx.fillText(G.combo, 3, 3);
    var cgd = ctx.createLinearGradient(-120,0,0,0);
    cgd.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,200,80,0.6)');
    cgd.addColorStop(1,'rgba(255,255,255,1)');
    ctx.fillStyle = cgd;
    ctx.fillText(G.combo, 0, 0);
    ctx.font = '700 15px ' + FONT;
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,215,140,'+(0.4+ck*0.6)+')';
    ctx.fillText('HITS', 0, 20);
    ctx.restore();
  }

  /* 静音按钮 */
  var m = muteRect();
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(10,18,28,0.72)';
  ctx.fillRect(m.x, m.y, m.w, m.h);
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(120,220,255,0.30)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  ctx.strokeRect(m.x+0.5, m.y+0.5, m.w-1, m.h-1);
  ctx.fillStyle = AU.muted ? 'rgba(255,110,130,0.95)' : 'rgba(150,235,255,0.95)';
  var mx = m.x + 13, my = m.y + m.h*0.5;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(mx, my-4);
  ctx.lineTo(mx+6, my-4);
  ctx.lineTo(mx+13, my-10);
  ctx.lineTo(mx+13, my+10);
  ctx.lineTo(mx+6, my+4);
  ctx.lineTo(mx, my+4);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();
  if(AU.muted){
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(mx+17, my-6); ctx.lineTo(mx+28, my+6);
    ctx.moveTo(mx+28, my-6); ctx.lineTo(mx+17, my+6);
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,110,130,0.95)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2.2;
    ctx.stroke();
  } else {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(mx+15, my, 7, -0.9, 0.9);
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(150,235,255,0.9)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(mx+15, my, 11, -0.8, 0.8);
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(150,235,255,0.45)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.8;
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  /* 按键提示 */
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  ctx.font = '600 12.5px ' + FONT;
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(150,205,235,0.46)';
  var hint = 'A/D 移动   Space 跳跃(二段)   J 斩击连段   K 蓄力重斩 / 空中下劈   L 冲刺闪避   I 挑空   R 重开';
  ctx.fillText(hint, 30, VH - 20);

  /* 标题 / 死亡 */
  if(G.state === 'title') drawTitle();
  if(G.state === 'dead') drawDeath();
}

function drawPip(x, y, label, v, col){

  ctx.globalAlpha = 0.22;
  ctx.fillRect(x+1, y+1, 50, 14);

  ctx.fillStyle = col;
  ctx.fillRect(x+1, y+1, 50*clamp(v,0,1), 14);
  ctx.font = '700 11px ' + FONT;
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(220,250,255,0.9)';

}

    ctx.fillRect(0,0,VW,VH);

    var g = ctx.createRadialGradient(VW*0.5, VH*0.5, Math.min(VW,VH)*0.22, VW*0.5, VH*0.5, Math.max(VW,VH)*0.75);

/* =====================================================================
   主渲染
   ===================================================================== */
function render(){
  ctx.setTransform(DPR,0,0,DPR,0,0);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#04060b';
  ctx.fillRect(0,0,CW,CH);

  drawBG();

  setWorld();
  drawGround();
  drawDecals();
  drawLimbs();

  var i;
  for(i=0;i<enemies.length;i++) drawEnemy(enemies[i]);
  drawPlayer();
  drawFX();
  drawOrbs();

  setScreen();
  drawOverlayFX();
  drawHUD();
}

/* =====================================================================
   更新总调度
   ===================================================================== */
function tick(dt){
  G.t += dt;

  if(G.state === 'title'){
    updateCam(dt);
    updateFX(dt);
    updateLimbs(dt);
    P.anim += dt;
    P.armAng = computeArmAng();
    updateScarf(dt);
    if(G.flash > 0) G.flash -= dt*4;
    if(G.red > 0) G.red -= dt*2.2;
    return;
  }

  if(G.hitstop > 0){
    G.hitstop -= dt;
    updateFX(dt*0.30);
    updateLimbs(dt*0.30);
    updateCam(dt*0.5);
    G.shake *= Math.pow(0.02, dt);
    if(G.flash > 0) G.flash -= dt*4;
    if(G.red > 0) G.red -= dt*2.2;
    if(G.bannerT > 0) G.bannerT -= dt;
    return;
  }

  for(var k in BUF){ if(BUF[k] > 0) BUF[k] -= dt; }

  updatePlayer(dt);
  updateEnemies(dt);
  updateOrbs(dt);
  updateFX(dt);
  updateLimbs(dt);
  updateCam(dt);
  updateWaves(dt);

  if(G.state === 'dead') G.deathT += dt;

  if(G.flash > 0) G.flash -= dt*4;
  if(G.red > 0) G.red -= dt*2.2;
  if(G.bannerT > 0) G.bannerT -= dt;
  if(G.comboT > 0){ G.comboT -= dt; if(G.comboT <= 0) G.combo = 0; }
}

  AU.init();

  orbs.length = 0;
  fx.length = 0;
  limbs.length = 0;
  shocks.length = 0;
  decals.length = 0;
  nums.length = 0;

  P.hp = P.maxHp; P.ghost = P.maxHp; P.dead = false;
  P.onGround = true; P.jumps = 0; P.airDash = 1;
  P.atk = null; P.chain = 0; P.airChain = 0; P.comboT = 0;

  P.inv = 0; P.hurtT = 0;

  G.state = 'play';

/* =====================================================================
   初始化场景（标题画面）

(function initScene(){

  cam.x = clamp(P.x - VW*0.5, 0, Math.max(0, ARENA - VW));
  cam.y = GROUND - VH*0.84;

/* =====================================================================
   主循环
   ===================================================================== */
var lastT = (typeof performance !== 'undefined' && performance.now) ? performance.now() : Date.now();
var acc = 0;

function frame(now){
  var dt = (now - lastT)/1000;
  lastT = now;
  if(!(dt > 0)) dt = 0;
  if(dt > 0.05) dt = 0.05;

  /* 固定步长（最多 3 步） */
  acc += dt;
  var steps = 0;
  while(acc >= 1/120 && steps < 4){
    tick(1/120);
    acc -= 1/120;
    steps++;
  }
  if(steps === 0 && acc > 0){
    tick(acc);
    acc = 0;
  }
  if(acc > 0.2) acc = 0;

  render();
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
}
requestAnimationFrame(frame);

/* =====================================================================
   外部只读状态
   ===================================================================== */
window.combatBenchState = function(){
  var alive = 0;
  for(var i=0;i<enemies.length;i++) if(!enemies[i].dead) alive++;
  return {
    ready: true,
    playerAlive: !P.dead && P.hp > 0,
    enemyCount: alive,
    hitCount: G.hitCount,
    limbBreakCount: G.limbBreak,
    playing: G.state === 'play'
  };
};

})();
